+package signup
+
+import (
+	"context"
+
+	"github.com/acme/signup-sync/internal/sms"
+)
+
+// Run enqueues one sign-up SMS when the opted-in number is already in the base.
+func (c *Consumer) Run(ctx context.Context, optIn OptIn) error {
+	hash := c.hasher.Hash(optIn.Number)
+	eligibles, err := c.q.GetEligiblesByClientAndNumber(ctx, optIn.ClientID, hash)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if len(eligibles) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	member := eligibles[0]
+	return c.enqueue(ctx, SignupSMS{MemberID: member.ID, Number: optIn.Number})
+}
+
+// Send mints the sign-up token for the queued member and texts it to the number.
+func (c *Consumer) Send(ctx context.Context, item SignupSMS) error {
+	member, err := c.q.GetMemberByID(ctx, item.MemberID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	token, err := c.tokens.Generate(ctx, member.ID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	link := c.links.Signup(token)
+	return c.sender.SendSMS(ctx, item.Number, sms.Template{
+		Name: member.FullName,
+		Link: link,
+	})
+}

@@ -9,3 +9,12 @@
 		     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)`,
 		m.ID, m.ClientID, m.EmployeeID, m.MobileHash, m.FullName)
 }
+
+// SyncMember refreshes a known member from the upstream feed.
+func (q *Queries) SyncMember(ctx context.Context, m Member) error {
+	return q.exec(ctx,
+		`UPDATE core.eligible_member
+		    SET mobile_number = $3, full_name = $4, updated_at = now()
+		  WHERE client_id = $1 AND employee_id = $2`,
+		m.ClientID, m.EmployeeID, m.MobileHash, m.FullName)
+}
